_comment: Server catalog — the fleet's machines by STABLE NAME (mDNS/DNS), not IP. Anything that needs a fleet machine resolves it from here at startup/reconcile time (facetwork/servers/catalog.py), so a DHCP-drifted address heals on the next resolution instead of requiring /etc/hosts edits on every host. Per-deployment override: servers.local.json (merged over this file, matched by name; top-level "_remove": [names] drops entries) or FW_SERVERS_FILE=<path> (full replace). Set ip_pin ONLY for hosts that mDNS/DNS cannot resolve (e.g. across subnets) — a pinned IP reintroduces the drift problem this file exists to remove. See servers.example.json and docs/reference/server-catalog.md.

servers.name: server3.local
servers.purpose: infra: MongoDB, MinIO, PostGIS, dashboard, image registry (+ heavy runner tier, 14 TB disk)

servers.name: MaxPro.local
servers.purpose: heavy runner tier (osm PBF imports, wide fan-outs)
